title: Connections to offsets and bases of stacks.
officialText:
Horizontal branches shall connect to the bases of stacks at a point located not less
than 10 times the diameter of the drainage stack downstream from the stack. Except as prohibited by Section 711.2, horizontal
branches shall connect to horizontal stack offsets at a point located not less than 10 times the diameter of the drain age stack
downstream from the upper stack.
